title: Hosting
disabled: Web hosting is not enabled on this server.
configError: Unable to load the hosting configuration.

php-nginx.label: PHP + Nginx
php-nginx.description: PHP-FPM behind Nginx: fast, suited to most PHP applications (WordPress, Laravel, Symfony).

php-apache.label: PHP + Apache
php-apache.description: PHP with Apache: supports .htaccess files, for applications that rely on them.

nginx.label: Static (Nginx)
nginx.description: Nginx serving static files: HTML sites, single-page applications, generated sites.

apache.label: Static (Apache)
apache.description: Apache serving static files, with .htaccess support.

status.modifiedTooltip: The compose file was edited outside the panel.

php.deprecatedTooltip: This PHP version no longer receives security updates.

support.activeTooltip: Active support: bugs and security issues are fixed.
support.securityTooltip: Security support: only security issues are fixed. After this date, the version receives no updates at all.

actions.busy: An operation is in progress on this hosting

confirm.stop: Stop the hosting "{{name}}"? The website will be unavailable.
confirm.restart: Restart the hosting "{{name}}"? The website will be briefly unavailable.

redeploy.title: Redeploy "{{name}}"
redeploy.description: Recreates the container from the current settings.
redeploy.pull: Pull the latest image (update PHP / web server patches)
redeploy.modifiedWarning: The compose file of this hosting was edited outside the panel. It will be deployed as is, manual changes included.
redeploy.modifiedConfirm: I understand: deploy the manually edited compose file

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"
delete.description: The container and its configuration will be removed. The site files are kept unless you choose otherwise.
delete.purgeWarning: This cannot be undone. SFTP users of the site "{{site}}" will lose all their files.

detail.notFound: This hosting does not exist or has been deleted.
detail.noSpec: The settings of this hosting cannot be read.

overview.noContainers: No container: the hosting is not deployed.
overview.usageNotRunning: No running container: start the hosting to see its memory and CPU usage.

detail.secretsMasked: Secret values (environment variables, configuration snippets) are hidden for this API key: the settings are read-only.

compose.help: The compose.yaml used to run this hosting. It is a standard Docker Compose file: running `docker compose up -d` in the hosting directory boots it without the panel.
compose.modified: This file was edited outside the panel: it no longer matches the settings. Saving the settings will overwrite it.
compose.masked: The compose file is not shown: this API key cannot read secrets.
compose.routingFileHelp: Routing file currently used by the web server.

modifiedAlert.title: This hosting was modified outside the panel
modifiedAlert.description: Saving will regenerate the compose file and overwrite the manual changes.

forceConfirm.title: Overwrite the manual changes?
forceConfirm.content: The compose file of "{{name}}" was edited outside the panel. Saving replaces it with the settings of this form: the manual changes will be lost.

operation.none: No operation has been run since the API started.

template.editHelp: Only templates of the same kind can be selected for an existing hosting.

name.label: Name
name.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes (max {{max}} characters). Cannot be changed later.
name.invalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not starting or ending with a dash
name.checkFailed: Unable to check the name availability

taken.stack: A hosting already uses this name
taken.directory: A directory with this name already exists
taken.compose_project: A Docker Compose stack already uses this name
taken.container: A container already uses this name
taken.traefik_router: A Traefik router already uses this name

site.label: Site directory
site.tooltip: Directory under {{dir}} holding the website files. It can be shared with SFTP users and cannot be changed later.
site.newHelp: A directory named after the hosting will be created: {{path}}
site.noneAvailable: No free directory: every existing site is already used by a hosting.
site.readOnly: The site directory of a hosting cannot be changed.

documentRoot.label: Document root
documentRoot.tooltip: Directory served by the web server, relative to the site directory. Leave empty to serve the site root.
documentRoot.invalid: Relative path: letters, digits and . _ @ + ~ - in segments separated by /, without "." or ".." segments
documentRoot.webTooltip: Classic layout: the site files are in web/.
documentRoot.publicTooltip: Symfony / Laravel layout: the site files are in public/. On PHP templates, also enables Symfony routing.

domains.label: Domains
domains.help: Type a domain then press Enter. At most {{max}} domains.

https.label: HTTPS
https.help: Enable HTTPS once the DNS of every domain points to this server, otherwise the certificate cannot be issued.

phpVersion.label: PHP version
phpVersion.deprecatedWarning: This PHP version is no longer maintained: plan an upgrade.

memory.label: Memory limit
memory.help: Optional. When the container reaches its memory limit, Docker kills it: leave this off unless you need to cap usage.

cpus.label: CPU limit
cpus.help: Optional. Without a limit, the container can use every CPU core of the server.

memoryLimit.label: memory_limit
memoryLimit.tooltip: Maximum memory per PHP script, e.g. 256M, or -1 for unlimited.
memoryLimit.invalid: Expected a size such as 256M, or -1
memoryLimit.help: Also the default for web requests when the web limit is empty.

uploadMaxFilesize.label: upload_max_filesize
uploadMaxFilesize.tooltip: Maximum size of an uploaded file, e.g. 64M.

postMaxSize.label: post_max_size
postMaxSize.tooltip: Maximum size of a request body; must be at least upload_max_filesize.
postMaxSize.tooSmall: Must be greater than or equal to upload_max_filesize

maxExecutionTime.label: max_execution_time
maxExecutionTime.tooltip: Maximum execution time of a script, in seconds (0 = unlimited).
maxExecutionTime.help: Web only: PHP in the command line (crons) is never time-limited; limit a cron with php -d max_execution_time=N.

displayErrors.label: display_errors
displayErrors.tooltip: Show PHP errors in the pages. Keep disabled in production.

env.label: Environment variables
env.nameInvalid: Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit
env.nameReserved: This variable is managed by the panel
env.valueInvalid: The value must fit on a single line
env.help: Variables managed by the panel (PHP_*, WEB_DOCUMENT_ROOT, APPLICATION_*, CONTAINER_*, LD_*) cannot be set here.

phpIni.label: Additional php.ini
phpIni.tooltip: Loaded after every other PHP configuration file.

vhost.label: Additional virtual host directives
vhost.tooltipNginx: Nginx directives included inside the server block.
vhost.tooltipApache: Apache directives included inside the VirtualHost block.
vhost.helpNginx: Inserted inside the server block of the image: do not paste a full server { } block. The image already defines location / and location ~ \.php$ (fastcgi_pass php); change them in the Routing section. Example:
vhost.helpApache: Inserted inside the VirtualHost block of the image: do not paste a full VirtualHost block. Change the routing in the Routing section. Example:

phpModules.label: PHP modules
phpModules.help: Switch off the modules this site does not need.
phpModules.loading: Loading the modules of this PHP image…
phpModules.loadingHint: The first time, the image is downloaded: this can take a minute or two.
phpModules.error: Unable to load the modules of this PHP image.
phpModules.selectVersion: Select a PHP version to list its modules.
phpModules.ioncubeWarning: ionCube runs encoded PHP; it is disabled by default because it is commonly used by malware (e.g. ransomware).

framework.label: Framework
framework.noneHelp: Image routing: files are served as they are and PHP files run directly.
framework.overriddenByCustom: Inactive while custom rules are used: they replace the framework rules.
framework.siteRootWarning: The document root is not a "public" directory: project files such as .env, composer.json, vendor/, var/ or storage/ would be served. {{framework}} expects its "public" directory as document root (e.g. "public" or "web/public").

symfony.helpNginx: Every request falls back to index.php (try_files $uri /index.php$is_args$args). Only the front controller runs: /index.php called directly and other .php files return 404.
symfony.helpApache: FallbackResource /index.php on the document root: every request for a missing file reaches the front controller.

laravel.helpNginx: Requests fall back to index.php (try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string); only index.php runs, other .php files return 404, dotfiles are denied except .well-known, and 404 pages are handled by Laravel.
laravel.helpApache: FallbackResource /index.php with AllowOverride All (Laravel's public/.htaccess applies), no directory listing, dotfiles denied.

assetDirs.label: Asset directories
assetDirs.help: Directories inside the document root served as static files only: a missing file returns 404 instead of reaching the front controller.
assetDirs.invalid: Invalid directory: {{dir}} (letters, digits and . _ @ + ~ - in segments separated by /, without "." or "..")

custom.label: Customize the rules
custom.helpNginx: Your rules replace the routing of the image (its location / file), included before the PHP location: you may redefine location / and add regex locations. PHP-FPM is the upstream php (fastcgi_pass php;).
custom.helpApache: Your rules replace the routing of the image and are included first inside the VirtualHost.
custom.noPrefill: No generated rules for static templates: start from an empty file.

rules.label: Routing rules
rules.resetConfirm: Replace the current rules with the generated rules?
rules.prefillInvalid: Fix the highlighted fields (document root, asset directories) before generating the rules.

routing.familyWarning: These rules were written for {{from}} and the template now uses {{to}}: the syntax differs, review them before saving.
routing.rulesWrongFamily: These rules are written for the previous web server: rewrite them for {{family}}.

webMemoryLimit.label: Web memory limit
webMemoryLimit.tooltip: Memory limit of web requests (PHP-FPM); the application cannot raise it with ini_set. Leave empty to use the command line limit.

networks.label: Networks
networks.help: Private networks the site joins: it reaches the services and the sites on them by their name (e.g. svc-postgres-17). The shared network "services" gives access to the service instances on it.
networks.extra: Changing the networks redeploys the site (a few seconds of downtime).

runtime.subtitle: PHP version, limits, settings and modules

runtimeStatic.subtitle: Memory and CPU limits of the container
